packageRules.description: Runtime packages: one weekly PR for minor and patch updates, merged by a person after testing on real hardware. Sensor libraries reach a kernel driver, which the CI cannot test.
Build-only packages (analyzers, test tools) never ship to users: their minor and patch updates merge themselves once the CI gate is green.
The settings window's page: one weekly PR for its npm packages' minor and patch updates, pinned exactly with the lockfile, merged by a person after its Playwright tests.
GitHub Actions in their own PR, merged automatically once the CI gate is green.
Major updates: one PR each, outside the weekly schedule once the 7-day wait is over, reviewed by a person.
